# [TASK] Admin Dashboard page (Eureka/Gateway/Kibana/metrics links, ADMIN-only)



## Task
A `/admin` page in the frontend (`frontend/filmpire`), visible only to logged-in users whose role is `ADMIN`, with cards linking to the ops tools already running: Eureka discovery, the gateway's health/routes, Kibana, and metrics.

## Why
These tools already exist as separate ports devs have to remember (8761, 5601, gateway actuator...). There's no single place to check "is everything up" after logging into the app.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] NavBar shows an "Admin" link only when `user.role === 'ADMIN'` (role is already returned by login and `/api/v1/users/profile` today — no backend DTO change needed for this)
- [x] `/admin` route redirects non-admins (and logged-out users) to `/`
- [x] Dashboard has 4 cards, each an outbound link + a lightweight up/down check (`fetch` against the tool's health endpoint):
  - Discovery — `REACT_APP_DISCOVERY_URL` (default `http://localhost:8761`)
  - Gateway — `{gateway}/actuator/health` and `{gateway}/actuator/gateway/routes`
  - Kibana — `REACT_APP_KIBANA_URL` (default `http://localhost:5601`)
  - Metrics — `{gateway}/actuator/prometheus` by default; if `REACT_APP_GRAFANA_URL` is set (e.g. deployed against minikube/AKS), link there instead
- [x] All URLs configurable via `.env`/`.env.local`, none hardcoded

## Not in scope
- Standing up a local Prometheus/Grafana in docker-compose — that stack only exists for the minikube/k8s deployment today (ARCHITECTURE.md §12). This page links to whatever's configured; it doesn't add new infra.
- Any admin *write* actions (user management, etc.) — read-only ops view only.

## Estimate
**Hours:** not estimated (closed before hour estimates were required)

## Notes
- `Role.ADMIN` exists on `User` and is already returned by login/`/users/profile`, but nothing ever assigns it today — promoting an account to admin needs a manual DB update for now.
- No route is currently gated by role anywhere in the backend (the gateway extracts roles into `ROLE_*` authorities and an `X-User-Roles` header but nothing checks them) — the `/admin` gating in this ticket is frontend-only. If a future admin-only API endpoint is added, gate it there too.
